column1: # All six models settled; none left out.

# File 800100 (file800100) holds only the package actor_800100 - no pe2img/pe2clut chunk - so the variant file overwrites no image of it. The reverse happens at run time: actor_800100's embedded GpuImageUpload frames are uploaded into the variant's shared page through actorRenderUploadTexture (src/gameplay/world_targets.c:1126), at x = 0x180 + texturePageOffset*64, y = 0x100 + rect.y, i.e. onto the shifted characters/kyle/image.

# One companion file pair per session: 800100 plus index companionVariant (src/gameplay/cd_loading.c:1151-1156), queued from load_screen.c:549 only when companionSelectForArea reports a change; a new variant file replaces the previous one at the same load address 0x80167A70 and the same VRAM positions.

# Loader rule used above (src/main/fs.c:357, 1635, 1779): imageXPageOffset moves only strips whose y >= 256 (or load mode 2); imageYOffset moves only image headers at rows 245..255. So in a companion file the body page/CLUT (384,256 / row 245) lands at page +4, row +6, and the weapon image/CLUT (448,64 / row 244) stays where stored.

# Not checked: whether the player's own weapon file (loaded at 0/0) writes the same (448,64) / row 244 area as the companion's weapon image; that would be a later overwrite, not a different source file for these models.
# resourceVariant writers searched by field name only (values 1,2,3,4); a write through a copied PlayerStatus block (save load) was not traced, but descriptor 8 has no model in any case.
# Left open on purpose: enemies/golem/no_9/radio. Its page falls on file 451100's second image, but its palette row (246) is
